evals.prompt: Review this React component and refactor it so it does not use useEffect for derived state: it stores visibleTodos in state and updates it from todos and filter in an Effect.
evals.expected_output: Removes redundant state and Effect, derives visibleTodos during render or uses useMemo only if the filtering is expensive, and explains why this avoids stale renders.

evals.prompt: Fix a React form that sends a POST request from a useEffect after setting submittedData state in handleSubmit.
evals.expected_output: Moves the POST request into handleSubmit, removes the submittedData state and Effect, and explains that submitting is event-caused logic.

evals.prompt: A contact edit form resets name and email with useEffect whenever savedContact changes. Refactor it so selecting a different contact resets the form without an Effect.
evals.expected_output: Splits the form into an outer wrapper and keyed inner form using savedContact.id as the key, removes the reset Effect, and keeps explicit Reset button behavior.
